name: @arp/mcp
description: The ARP MCP server: reads the graph, prepares unsigned plans, serves a skill's file and signs a receipt for it. Signs no transaction.

scripts.start: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../../packages/protocol build && bun build src/server.ts src/fetch-skill.ts src/session-log.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming 'arp-[name].js' --target=bun --external viem --external 'viem/*' --banner '#!/usr/bin/env bun'
